frank: Postmortem follow-up: last week's pager bursts. We need clear owners, short ETAs, and a canary plan for any alert rule changes. Keep updates here.
jules: I'll own dedupe and grouping. Plan: 30s sliding dedupe keyed by (service, host) + ignore repeated identical messages from same source. ETA 5 business days.
nina: I'll do thresholds and retire candidates. Running a baseline job to compute p95/p99 per service over 60d. ETA 4 days.
pager-bot: Incident 2025-02-14: retry-loop-pager  312 pages in 3.5h. Runbook: https://redwood.incidents/2025-02-14-retry-loop (auto-attached).
zach: I'll draft the paging policy: soft-page to #alerts for non-SLA, hard-page for Sev0/1, auto-escalate after 10m. Will include canary plan (5% traffic) and rollback steps. ETA 7 days.
frank: Good. Add owner + ETA to tracker: https://docs.redwood/pmt/alert-followups. We'll create JIRA tasks for tracking.
jules: local dedupe config I'm testing in staging:
```yaml
alert: downstream-errors
expr: sum(rate(errors_total[5m])) by (service, host)
for: 3m
dedupe_key: "{{service}}:{{host}}"
dedupe_window: 30s
```
nina: SQL I'm using to rank noisy alerts:
```sql
SELECT alert_name, count(*) AS fires, percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (value) AS p95
FROM alert_fires
WHERE ts > now() - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY alert_name
ORDER BY fires DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
zach: One decision: do we allow short suppressions (1h) by SRE lead without incident manager sign-off? I'll propose in the doc.
frank: Yes, propose who can approve which durations. Include a quick rollback checklist and a post-rollout review at 7 days.
jules: PR will be up to add dedupe template to staging tomorrow morning; will tag @nina and @zach.
nina: I'll attach baseline graphs to the tracker after the job finishes tonight.
